text: The Royal Commission for AlUla was established by royal decree in July 2017 to preserve and develop AlUla, in north-west Saudi Arabia; its website is an official government website of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

source.name: UNESCO: Royal Commission for AlUla and UNESCO sign pioneering agreement for cultural collaboration
source.quote: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) was established by royal decree in July 2017 to preserve and develop AlUla, a region of outstanding natural and cultural significance in north-west Saudi Arabia.
